decisive_question.question_text: Does the prior A-short steady 5d CSI1000 excess signal survive same-anchor re-audit, or was it mainly a measurement-basis artifact?
decisive_question.prior_signal_under_review: Existing 24-month v7.10 production Tier1 view showed 5d excess_csi1000 t-stat about +2.88, while 20d was not significant. The 5d clue is treated as unvalidated until same-anchor stock and benchmark entry anchors are audited.

frozen_design.strategy_ref: A-EGS/egs_main.py v7.10 production Tier1 steady-lane output, using existing 24 monthly backtest cohorts only

cohort_window.description: 24 production monthly periods already used by the current A-short rank-backtest evidence surface; no rerun, refetch, or cohort regeneration in this preregistration slice.

universe_rule: Use the existing production Tier1 steady-lane candidate surface only.
Keep current universe, ranking cap, entry eligibility, limit-up buyability handling, and veto definitions frozen.
Do not add Tier2 or full-universe rescue rows in this steady-lane re-audit.
frozen_design.entry_rule: A-share stock entry is T+1 open after the screening as-of date; limit-up unbuyable entries must stay excluded or pending according to the existing production semantics.
frozen_design.cost_model: Use net T+1 return with existing A-share trading costs: commission, sell-side stamp tax, and slippage assumptions already used by the production rank-backtest evidence surface.

diagnostics: Report 5d and 20d net benchmark excess for CSI1000 and CSI300.
Treat CSI1000 5d as the decisive clue under review; 20d and CSI300 are required diagnostics, not a new fishing sweep.
Use monthly clustered statistics and also show raw per-month results.

integrity_checks.plan: State the prior exploratory search surface and apply a conservative correction / discount before treating the 5d t-stat as evidence. Do not add new parameter scans.
Show monthly behavior, concentration by stock, mean versus tail contribution, and high / low momentum-std regime slices instead of relying only on aggregate t-stat.
Regress or proxy lane returns against CSI300 / CSI1000 and a size proxy to check whether the result is mostly market beta or small-cap exposure.
Compare with-filter versus without-filter views for OVERHEAT, Tier2 demotion, chasing-high, and related vetoes; separate real net-excess improvement from simply trading fewer names.
Confirm the 24-month A-share universe uses the existing Tushare list / delist / suspend guards and does not silently back-delete failed names, suspended names, or limit-up buy failures.

candidate_alpha_not_full_size: Corrected same-anchor 5d CSI1000 net excess remains positive after multiple-testing discount.
20d and CSI300 diagnostics do not contradict the 5d result in a way that points to a measurement artifact.
Monthly, stock-level, distribution, and regime slices do not show that the result is only a few outliers or one month.
Factor exposure check does not reduce the result to benchmark beta or small-cap exposure.
Even if this label is reached, it is only a candidate alpha clue and still needs deeper validation plus at least 12 months live-normalized forward evidence before any ship-gate or full-size claim.
risk_filter_only: Veto / filter checks reduce bad tickets, drawdown, or execution-quality failures, but corrected same-anchor excess does not prove independent picker alpha.
This keeps A-short steady useful as a risk-control and evidence loop, not as a full-size alpha lane.
falsified: Corrected same-anchor 5d CSI1000 signal disappears or fails the adjusted significance / robustness checks.
The result is dominated by outliers, one regime, factor exposure, or measurement artifacts.
No production promotion, no silent rerun, and no parameter rescue without a new reviewed preregistration.

next_steps: Independent review must verify this preregistration before any outcome run.
After a clean review and an explicit user execute command, run only the frozen same-anchor re-audit on existing local evidence; do not fetch data or regenerate cohorts.
The future result must be written as a research-only evidence report and summarized in plain language: data usable as alpha evidence, risk-filter only, or falsified.
limitations: This artifact records the plan only; it calculates no return, t-stat, Sharpe, drawdown, or alpha result.
This artifact does not prove that A-short steady has alpha.
This artifact does not authorize production, full-size manual use, Phase 7c, DataHub, provider access, runner changes, or broker / order automation.
A future positive backtest result is still not enough for full-size use; the fixed 12-month forward-live ship-gate requirement remains.
